title: link_layer: ReceiveError.REPLAY returned for TOFU pin capacity exhaustion
description:
At line 1665-1666 in link_layer.py, when TOFU pin capacity is exhausted (all existing pins have active generation leases), the code returns ReceiveError.REPLAY. This is semantically incorrect - the frame is not being replayed; the counter is fresh. The actual failure is resource exhaustion.

Impact:
- Monitoring confusion: Security monitoring watching for replay attacks gets false positives
- Debugging difficulty: Operators troubleshooting capacity issues see misleading error codes
- Protocol confusion: Upper layers may respond to REPLAY differently than capacity errors

Security Note: Security behavior is correct (fail closed). This is a semantic/operational issue, not a vulnerability.

Suggested Fix: Either add ReceiveError.CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED variant, or document that REPLAY can mean 'cannot safely admit peer' in addition to 'counter replay'.

Location: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py:1665-1666
